## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A named geodetic datum: the reference ellipsoid against which latitude,
// longitude, and altitude are expressed (for example "WGS84").
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geodetic_datum)
type GeodeticDatum
{
    Name: String;
    Ellipsoid: ReferenceEllipsoid;
}

//==
// # Map projections

// The projection family used to flatten geodetic coordinates onto a plane.
// The conic family carries its two standard parallels.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Map_projection)
type MapProjectionFamily
    = Mercator
    | WebMercator
    | Utm
    | LambertConformalConic(FirstStandardParallel: Angle, SecondStandardParallel: Angle)
    | Stereographic
    | Equirectangular
    | AzimuthalEquidistant;

// A configured map projection. The false easting and northing offset all
// projected coordinates so they stay positive across the region of use.
type MapProjection
{
    Family: MapProjectionFamily;
    CentralMeridian: Angle;
    FalseEasting: Length;
    FalseNorthing: Length;
}

// One zone of the Universal Transverse Mercator grid: ZoneNumber is 1 to 60
// (each spanning 6 degrees of longitude), split into a northern and a
// southern hemisphere half.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Transverse_Mercator_coordinate_system)
type UtmZone
    implements IValue
{
    ZoneNumber: Integer;
    NorthernHemisphere: Boolean;
}

//==
// # Cartesian geospatial coordinates

// A position on a projected map plane: easting (X) and northing (Y) from the
// projection origin. ZoneNumber identifies the UTM or grid zone, and is 0
// when the projection is not zonal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Projected_coordinate_system)
type ProjectedCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    Easting: Length;
    Northing: Length;
    ZoneNumber: Integer;
}

// An Earth-centered, Earth-fixed Cartesian position: origin at the planet's
// center of mass, X toward the prime meridian on the equator, Z toward the
// north pole, Y completing the right-handed frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earth-centered,_Earth-fixed_coordinate_system)
type EcefCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    X: Length;
    Y: Length;
    Z: Length;
}

// A position in a local tangent frame anchored at Origin: East and North lie
// in the local horizontal plane, Up is along the ellipsoid normal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_tangent_plane_coordinates)
type EnuCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    East: Length;
    North: Length;
    Up: Length;
    Origin: GeoCoordinate;
}
```
